citation.authors: Karuppusamy A, Paul S, Chattopadhyay A, et al
citation.journal: Journal of Integrative and Complementary Medicine

cited_by.title: Vitiligo, spread, starting age and treatment options

record.population: 60 patients with vitiligo at a homeopathy institute in India
record.design: Double-blind randomised placebo-controlled pilot trial of individualised homeopathic medicines, 6 months
record.finding: Recruitment and retention were satisfactory and mean reductions in vitiligo and quality-of-life scores were larger with the homeopathic medicines than placebo. The authors conclude only that definitive efficacy trials are warranted.
record.note: A feasibility pilot, not an efficacy trial. Results were not tested for statistical significance in the abstract; funding not checked.
